description.en: Overhead conversation background with five whale species formed from custom text or ASCII, shaded cells, frosted content cards, input-box avoidance, independent dives, spouts, ripples, wind, and cloud shadows.
description.zh: 海面正上方俯视的对话背景，支持用自定义文字或 ASCII 组成五种鲸类，含彩色字格、内容框毛玻璃、输入框避让、独立下潜、喷水、尾拍涟漪、风纹与云影。
